_comment: Lifecycle violations accepted as the current state of the world, keyed by tools/lint_lifecycle.py's exact error string. The linter ratchets against this file in both directions: a violation not listed here fails CI, and a listed violation that no longer occurs ALSO fails CI until it is pruned. Zero violations is the preferred steady state and is valid; the list may only grow through an explicit reviewed acceptance of real debt. Every nonzero entry must carry its rationale as the value.
